Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Represents a workspace within the SaturnSync application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Workspace entity.

ownerId.description: Reference to User who owns the workspace. (Relationship: User 1:N Workspace)

Company.title: Company
Company.description: Represents a company within a workspace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Company entity.

workspaceId.description: Reference to Workspace that contains this company. (Relationship: Workspace 1:N Company)

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a project within a company.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Project entity.

companyId.description: Reference to Company that contains this project. (Relationship: Company 1:N Project)

completionPercentage.description: Automated completion percentage for the project.

Silo.title: Silo
Silo.description: Represents a silo within a project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Silo entity.

projectId.description: Reference to Project that contains this silo. (Relationship: Project 1:N Silo)

completionPercentage.description: Automated completion percentage for the Silo.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a task within a silo.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Task entity.

siloId.description: Reference to Silo that contains this task. (Relationship: Silo 1:N Task)

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the task is completed.

priority.description: Priority level of the task (low, medium, high).

assigneeId.description: Reference to User assigned to the task. (Relationship: User 1:N Task)

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the SaturnSync application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The email address of the user.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

WorkspaceUser.title: WorkspaceUser
WorkspaceUser.description: Represents the association between a user and a workspace, including the user's role.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkspaceUser entity.

workspaceId.description: Reference to the Workspace. (Relationship: Workspace 1:N WorkspaceUser)

userId.description: Reference to the User. (Relationship: User 1:N WorkspaceUser)

role.description: The role of the user within the workspace (e.g., admin, contributor, viewer).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Report entity.

reportType.description: Type of the report, e.g., PDF overview, live link.

data.description: The data associated with the report, potentially a URL or JSON structure.

workspaceId.description: Reference to the Workspace this report belongs to. (Relationship: Workspace 1:N Report)

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the SaturnSync application's requirements, focusing on secure access control, scalability, and maintainability. It leverages path-based ownership for user-related data and membership maps for collaborative access. Authorization Independence is achieved through denormalization of workspace membership data. Segregation of data based on access needs ensures that security rules are simplified and efficient. The structure is optimized for querying and listing operations (QAPs) by adhering to a consistent and predictable schema.

Specifically:

*   **Users:** User data is stored in a top-level `/users/{userId}` collection, ensuring easy access and management of individual user profiles. This path-based ownership is fundamental to private user data.
*   **Workspaces:** Workspaces are stored at `/workspaces/{workspaceId}`. The `ownerId` field establishes ownership. The `workspaceUsers` subcollection stores membership information.
*   **Workspace Users:** The `/workspaces/{workspaceId}/workspaceUsers/{workspaceUserId}` collection stores workspace user role information.
*   **Companies, Projects, Silos, Tasks:** These entities are nested under workspaces using hierarchical paths (e.g., `/workspaces/{workspaceId}/companies/{companyId}/projects/{projectId}/silos/{siloId}/tasks/{taskId}`). This structure enforces ownership and simplifies security rules based on workspace membership. Each document in the subcollections will contain workspace membership information to ensure authorization independence.
*   **Reports:** Reports are stored as `/workspaces/{workspaceId}/reports/{reportId}`. Access is controlled via workspace membership.

**Authorization Independence:**

*   The key to authorization independence lies in denormalizing workspace membership information into subcollections. For instance, when creating a new `Company` under a `Workspace`, the `members` map (derived from `/workspaces/{workspaceId}/workspaceUsers/{workspaceUserId}`) is copied into the `Company` document, as well as the `Project`, `Silo`, and `Task` documents. This allows security rules to validate access at each level without needing to perform costly `get()` operations to check parent-level permissions.

**QAPs (Rules Are Not Filters):**

*   The data structure supports secure list operations by ensuring all documents within a collection share the same security requirements. Path-based ownership (`/users/{userId}`) and workspace-based access control (`/workspaces/{workspaceId}/...`) guarantee that queries can be performed without exposing unauthorized data. The denormalized membership information enables rules to efficiently filter data based on the current user's role within the workspace.
